population: All frozen expanded-menu paired source choices at the original 10% review cap. A second independently collected reference is scored wherever available.
endpoint: Whether the difficulty-selected queue needs at least ceil(0.10 B) more checks to match the random-selected queue's yield at B.
evaluation: Exact certificate probabilities conditional on the frozen reference. Compare predeclared statistics and allocations. Report primary and second references separately. Use identical check limits and worst-case type-I control for every test. Additional held-out-corpus method selection uses first-reference outcomes from other corpora only.
